anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.property_overview_150_words: Experience the timeless elegance of Drostdy Hotel, a 5-star sanctuary nestled in the historic heart of Graaff-Reinet. Dating back to 1806, our meticulously renovated property blends authentic Karoo heritage with modern luxury. Discover beautifully appointed rooms, tranquil gardens, and a vibrant, memorabilia-filled bar that's a favorite among locals and travelers alike. Perfectly situated for exploring Graaff-Reinet's museums and cultural landmarks, Drostdy Hotel offers an immersive escape where impeccable service meets genuine Karoo hospitality. Indulge in a unique blend of relaxation and lively social atmosphere, making your stay an unforgettable journey into the soul of the Eastern Cape.
